% Pattern: proof/manual/article. A manual proof head with no end mark, and
% the next lemma right after the text of the proof.
% from math/0406514
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1 status=here
% want head-1 proof - proves=lem-1
% want lem-2 statement/lemma 2 status=here
% want head-2 proof - proves=lem-2
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{lem}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{lem} Each tree is a graph. \end{lem}

\proof:  Clear.

We write $T$ for a tree.

\begin{lem} Each path is a tree.
\end{lem}

\proof A path has no cycle.

\end{document}
